summary.note: Differences between the citeproc-js port and citeproc-js 2.4.63 on the CSL test suite fixtures of the ported areas (ported_areas.json). Each entry: fixture, citeproc_js (its output, made with citeproc-js 2.4.63 pinned 2019 locales), port (ours, on the current locales vendor/csl-locales a89adec), reason, equals_result (the harness asserts the port output equals the fixture RESULT). A listed difference is a recorded finding, never a tolerance. 13 entries, all D13 (newer CSL locale data), measured 2026-10-08 (#803).
